treatment_summary: Start ramipril as first‑line ACE‑I for hypertension, titrating to target dose, and review BP and renal function. Replace low‑dose simvastatin with atorvastatin 20 mg nightly to achieve guideline‑recommended lipid reduction. Initiate metformin XR 500 mg daily after confirming adequate renal function to address prediabetes. Continue hydrochlorothiazide only as needed pending BP control. Offer liraglutide for obesity if BMI ≥30 kg/m2 and no contraindications. Monitor labs, BP, weight, and adverse effects per NICE recommendations, and arrange lifestyle interventions (diet, exercise, alcohol reduction, diabetes prevention programme).
